messages:
sre-bot: ALERT fired — high 5xx rate on service-api endpoint /v1/generate (error_rate=6.8% over 2m). Pager: maria.g

maria.g: @channel ack. I'm oncall. Pulling up grafana and logs: https://grafana.redwoodops.com/d/ABcd123/service-latency

kevin.l: seeing correlating spikes from our upstream edge provider (edge-proxy). Lots of 502/504 at ~14:02 UTC. Could be their deploy.

maria.g: verifying customer impact. Quick query on prod logs shows elevated 502 responses for ~0.6% of requests for some customers but 5xx rate aggregated is 6.8% bc of a small noisy gateway.

alex.r: copying logs:
```
2026-03-14T14:03:12Z ERROR gateway timeout from edge-proxy-2: upstream 504
2026-03-14T14:03:13Z ERROR handler: upstream returned 502 for request id=sh_abc123
```

maria.g: I'll put a temporary routing rule to prefer model-variant-b (more tolerant) for traffic to reduce customer errors and enable prefix cache where safe. Applying now.

kevin.l: please also add a short-term fallback to cached responses for identical prompt hashes — reduces load on upstream.

maria.g: patch applied: routing -> model-variant-b, cache enabled for identical prompts. Observability: error rate dropped to ~1.1% in ~3m :thumbsup:

kevin.l: good mitigation. Follow-up: alert noise is concerning — current rule triggers too fast. Current prometheus-style alert rule: `sum(rate(http_requests_total{handler="/v1/generate",code=~"5.."}[2m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{handler="/v1/generate"}[2m])) > 0.04` for 2m.

maria.g: propose tuning: increase threshold to 5% and lengthen to 10m to avoid transient upstream blips causing full-bell page storms. Also add a separate alert for gateway-specific 502/504 spikes with a short window that routes to a provider-investigation runbook (not full oncall page).

alex.r: agree. Action items: (1) split alert into "customer-impacting-5xx" (>=5% over 5m) that pages oncall, (2) "gateway-degradation" (502|504 spikes over 2m) that notifies on-call Slack channel and creates an ops ticket but doesn't wake SRE unless sustained.

maria.g: I'll open a PR in infra-monitoring repo with the new rules + runbook link. Quick check: need a dashboard panel that breaks 5xx by gateway id and origin country. I'll add a Grafana playbook panel: https://grafana.redwoodops.com/d/XYZ/5xx-investigations

sre-bot: created issue RWD-5678 in Jira for "Tune /v1/generate 5xx alerts + dashboard + runbook" and assigned to eng-sre. Link: https://jira.redwoodops.com/browse/RWD-5678

kevin.l: important note: do NOT suppress all 5xx alerts. We still need a fast-detection path for genuine regressions (e.g., model rollout that causes errors). Suggest rule tagging: tag alerts with `impact=customer` vs `impact=infra` and add automatic fallback to canary routing for model rollouts.

maria.g: agreed. I'll include tagging and a brief runbook snippet: if customer-impacting-5xx -> rollback latest model rollout -> check top 10 failing prompts -> contact support for affected customers. If gateway-degradation -> scale alternative gateways, engage provider support after 15m if persists.

alex.r: also recommend adding a synthetic check (post/healthcheck) that exercises /v1/generate with a short prompt to detect semantic failures even if rate is low. That can be an early-warning metric.

maria.g: adding to RWD-5678 as follow-up tasks: dashboard panels, alert rule PR, runbook updates, create synthetic monitor (synth-5xx).

support-ops: customer-impact note: Support reported ~12 customers saw intermittent 502s and a handful filed tickets. We prepared outreach template: https://wiki.redwoodops.com/incident-templates/customer-502-template — will send once postmortem confirms scope.

maria.g: okay — handoff to night oncall @alex.r in 20m. Summary for handoff: mitigation applied (routing+cache), errors down to ~1%, RWD-5678 created (monitoring + runbook work), follow-ups: split alert rules, add dashboard, add synthetic check, customer outreach draft prepared.

alex.r: ack. I'll monitor next 6 hours and escalate if error_rate > 3% sustained for 15m. Also will watch gateway-specific panels and the provider status page.

kevin.l: thanks all. Postmortem owners: kevin.l (root cause analysis), alex.r (monitoring + dashboards), maria.g (customer comms).

maria.g: adding a quick PR note to infra-monitoring: `change threshold from 4%/2m -> 5%/10m; add gateway-specific rule; tag alerts with impact=*` will open now.

sre-bot: INCIDENT marked as mitigated by maria.g at 2026-03-14T14:12:30Z. Auto-close in 24h unless reopened.

maria.g: leaving final note: this was mostly upstream provider instability coincident with their deploy; mitigation was routing + cache. Follow-ups tracked in RWD-5678. If anyone sees regression reopen the thread or ping @pager oncall. :wave:
